verifications.claim: The Masters cut is determined after 36 holes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "36-hole cut" (R1); "after two rounds" (R2); "After the first two rounds (36 holes)" (R3); "36-hole cut" (R4); "after the second round" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state the cut is after 36 holes or two rounds.

verifications.claim: The Masters cut is determined by taking the top 50 players, including ties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "top 50 players and ties" (R1, R3); "top 50 and ties" (R2); "all players inside the top 50 (and any players tied)" (R4); "top 50 golfers and ties" (R6); "top 50 players and ties" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Directly and consistently supported across sources as the current rule.

verifications.claim: Any player at the Masters cut score or better advances to the weekend.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "top 50 players and ties make it through" (R1); "Any golfer outside that number... is eliminated" (R3); "all players inside the top 50 (and any players tied)" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: The top 50 and ties define the cut score; players at or better than that score advance.

verifications.claim: Players outside the top 50 miss the Masters cut.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "only the top 50 players and ties make it through" (R1); "Any golfer outside that number... eliminated" (R3); "outside the top 50 after the first round" (R4); "only the top 50 golfers and ties make the cut" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated that those outside top 50 (excluding ties at 50th) miss the cut.

verifications.claim: The 10-shot rule previously allowed players within 10 strokes of the lead to qualify.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "anyone within 10 shots of the lead also made it through. That “10-shot rule”" (R1); "those within 10 shots of the lead" (R2); "players within 10 strokes of the leader" (R3); "any player within 10 strokes of the lead—the so-called “10-shot rule”" (R4); "within 10 strokes of the leader" (R6)

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "2021–present: ... The 10-shot rule was scrapped" (R1); "changed in 2020" (R2); "adopted its current cut format in 2020" (R3); "Starting in 2020" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently cite 2020 as the year of elimination.

verifications.claim: The Masters cut targets the top 50 professional and amateur golfers and ties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "top 50 players and ties" (R1, R3); amateurs mentioned as ineligible for pay but in field (R1); "top 50 players and ties" includes pros/amateurs (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm top 50 players (field includes pros and amateurs) and ties; specification of pro/amateur is accurate but not always explicit.

verifications.claim: The Masters cut is established at the end of Friday's round.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "finalized at the conclusion of Round 2 on Friday" (R3); "end of Friday’s round" (R4); "Friday evening" (R7)

verifications.claim: Friday's round in The Masters is 36 holes.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Round 2 on Friday" (R3); "second round began at Augusta... end of Friday’s round" implying 18-hole rounds (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Cut after two 18-hole rounds (Thursday and Friday); Friday is only Round 2 (18 holes), not 36.

verifications.claim: There is no additional cut after 54 holes in The Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "There is no secondary cut at the Masters. Once players make the cut, they are guaranteed to compete in both Saturday and Sunday rounds."

verifications.claim: Masters professionals who miss the cut but finish 36 holes receive $15,000.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Augusta National pays $25,000 to every pro who doesn’t make the weekend"
verifications.reasoning: Only source mentioning payout specifies $25,000, directly contradicting $15,000.

verifications.claim: The Masters cutline was 6-over par in 2024
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.reasoning: R4 and R6 support +6; R7 contradicts with +7, creating conflicting information.
